test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option "No replacement required".

His comments were not __garmane__ to the topic at hand and distracted from the main issue.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. germane.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **'garmane'** is misspelled.
 
• The correct spelling is **'germane'**.
 
• 'Germane' is an adjective that means **'relevant or applicable to the subject at hand.'** *(संबंधित)*.

Correct sentence: His comments were not **germane** to the topic at hand and distracted from the main issue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Examples of usage:**
 
 
• The lawyer's argument was not germane to the case.
 
• Only germane points should be discussed during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Other options:**
 
 
• **germiane:** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **garmian:** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **No replacement required:** Incorrect because the original word is misspelled.
